decisions.reason: The stricter correction and quota-counting rules apply to the ongoing monthly approved-clip requirement, not the separate initial three-clip trial.
Publishing remains limited to client-approved clips; returning rejected clips for correction does not change publication eligibility or destination.
The source governs the ongoing monthly quota after hiring and does not change the distinct reference-matching requalification task.
The source changes rejection handling and quota counting but does not alter which published clips or performance metrics are tracked.
Mentioning training about moment selection does not establish a new source-selection rule or modify the existing task-local criteria.
Strict approval and correction handling do not change the requirement to provide a dedicated Instagram account.
The monthly approved-clip rule does not modify the separate extended trial's batch size, source content, or acceptance standard.
The source promises training about editing style but does not change the existing clean-editing or effects requirements.
The approval-gate modification does not change the required completeness, educational value, or standalone comprehension of clips.
The source does not specify any change to caption color, font, or effects.
The source's general promise of training does not modify the existing effective-hook criterion.
The stricter approval and rejected-clip counting rules do not change the required 30-to-90-second duration range.
